game.title: Buffalo Bills at Los Angeles Rams

lede: Buffalo Bills carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#1 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Los Angeles Rams +0.4 with a fair total of 53.9 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Buffalo Bills pass offence vs Los Angeles Rams pass defence, which sits +0.226 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
